![Design Thinking: A first kick of the can – Dino's Blog](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-ba32098f4f1b:4)
Design thinking is a human-centered, iterative process used to solve complex, poorly defined problems by prioritizing user needs and continuous experimentation.[[1]](https://www.ideou.com/pages/design-thinking)[[2]](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/5-stages-in-the-design-thinking-process)[[3]](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/what-is-design-thinking)

The standard framework, popularized by the Stanford d.school , consists of five core phases:[[1]](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/5-stages-in-the-design-thinking-process)

### The 5 Stages of Design Thinking

- **Empathize:** Understand your users by observing, interviewing, and immersing yourself in their real experiences to uncover their true needs and pain points.[[1]](https://lucid.co/blog/five-stages-of-design-thinking)[[2]](https://designthinking.ideo.com/process)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Im-djQsfVc0&t=8)
- **Define:** Analyze your research to state the user's core problems and needs in a clear, actionable problem statement.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Im-djQsfVc0&t=8)[[2]](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/5-stages-in-the-design-thinking-process)
- **Ideate:** Challenge assumptions and brainstorm a wide variety of creative, divergent solutions without judgment.[[1]](https://www.ideou.com/blogs/inspiration/design-thinking-process)[[2]](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/5-stages-in-the-design-thinking-process)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/EDV0tJtqT3w)
- **Prototype:** Build scaled-down, tangible versions of your best ideas (such as sketches, models, or basic digital layouts) to test the concepts.[[1]](https://lucid.co/blog/five-stages-of-design-thinking)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Im-djQsfVc0&t=8)
- **Test:** Share your prototypes with real users to gather feedback, learn what works, and refine your solutions.[[1]](https://lucid.co/blog/five-stages-of-design-thinking)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Im-djQsfVc0&t=8)

You can read more about how this applies in practice via the [Interaction Design Foundation](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/5-stages-in-the-design-thinking-process) or explore alternative breakdowns like the IDEO Design Thinking Framework.[[1]](https://www.ideou.com/pages/design-thinking)[[2]](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/5-stages-in-the-design-thinking-process)If you'd like to dive deeper, let me know:
